Board of County Commissioners

Welcome to the Board of County Commissioners website. We serve as the legislative and policy-setting body for county government. Our board is composed of three Commissioners, each elected to serve a four-year term. While each Commissioner represents a specific district, they are all elected by the entire county. Thank you for visiting our site and learning more about the important work we do for our community.
